title: AssetCatalog
description: This schema defines the AssetCatalog entity. An AssetCatalog is a node in the asset catalog tree structure with hierarchical support.

id.description: Unique identifier of an asset catalog instance.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Fully qualified name of the asset catalog.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this asset catalog.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

category.description: Reference to the AssetCategory this catalog belongs to.

parent.description: Reference to the parent AssetCatalog. Null for root level catalogs under a category.

level.description: Hierarchy level of the catalog. Starts from 1 for catalogs directly under a category. This field is automatically computed and cannot be modified.

order.description: Display order among siblings at the same level. This field can be modified to reorder catalogs.

reviewers.description: User references of the reviewers for this asset catalog.

assetCount.description: Total number of data assets under this catalog (including all children).

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Incremental change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.
